outcome: hospitalization in the neonatal ward for more than 6 hours
need for oxygen for more than an hour
need for continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP)
cohort: The study included 240 women with single pregnancies at high risk of late preterm delivery (34-37 weeks).
finding: Antenatal administration of betamethasone in late preterm deliveries (34-37 weeks) significantly improved neonatal respiratory morbidities and decreased the frequency of NICU admission.
